title: Buying Movie Tickets
context: Maya 晚上想和朋友看电影，在电影院售票处买票；售票员 Jordan 帮她选场次和座位，并说明学生优惠和入场时间。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Hi, I'd like two tickets for the 7:30 showing of The Late Train, please.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想买两张七点半这场《The Late Train》的票。

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Sure. Would you like standard seats or premium seats?
dialogue.zh: 好的。你要普通座位还是高级座位？

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Premium seats are closer to the center, and they lean back a little. They're five dollars more each.
dialogue.zh: 高级座位更靠中间，而且可以稍微向后靠。每张要多五美元。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Standard is fine. Can we sit together on the aisle?
dialogue.zh: 普通座位就行。我们能坐在一起、靠过道吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Let me check. Yes, I have two aisle seats in row G.
dialogue.zh: 我看一下。有的，G 排有两个靠过道的座位。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Perfect. Do you have a student discount?

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Yes, if you show a student ID, it's two dollars off each ticket. That brings it to twenty-four dollars total.
dialogue.zh: 有，出示学生证的话每张票减两美元。这样总共是二十四美元。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Great. Here's my ID, and I'll pay by card. What time should we arrive?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。这是我的学生证，我用卡付。我们该什么时候到？

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: The doors open about twenty minutes before the show. There's also a bag check at the entrance.
dialogue.zh: 开场前大约二十分钟开门。入口处还要检查一下包。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Got it. Can I get the tickets on my phone?
dialogue.zh: 明白了。票能发到我手机上吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jordan
dialogue.en: Yes, I'll email you the QR codes. Enjoy the movie!
dialogue.zh: 可以，我会把二维码发到你邮箱。祝你们观影愉快！

expressions.en: I'd like two tickets for the 7:30 showing
expressions.zh: 想买两张七点半这场的票，在售票处说明场次时常用。
expressions.example: Hi, I'd like two tickets for the 7:30 showing of The Late Train, please.

expressions.zh: 靠过道的座位，进出比较方便。
expressions.example: Can we sit together on the aisle? I have two aisle seats in row G.

expressions.zh: 学生优惠。买票时出示学生证往往可以便宜一些。
expressions.example: Do you have a student discount?

expressions.zh: 这样加起来是……，用来说明折扣后的总价。
expressions.example: That brings it to twenty-four dollars total.

expressions.zh: 祝观影愉快！出票后常用的道别。
expressions.example: I'll email you the QR codes. Enjoy the movie!

pronunciation: aisle 的 s 不发音，读作 /aɪl/；tickets 读作 /ˈtɪkɪts/；discount 的重音在第一音节，读作 /ˈdɪskaʊnt/；showing 读作 /ˈʃoʊɪŋ/；entrance 的重音在第一音节，读作 /ˈentrəns/。

practice.title: Part 1 · Movies
practice.prompt: Do you often go to the movies?
practice.answer: Yes, I do. I usually go to the movies once or twice a month, often on weekends. I like buying tickets at the theater so I can choose my seats.

practice.title: Part 2 · Buying tickets
practice.prompt: Describe an imagined time you bought movie tickets at a theater. Say what movie you chose, how you asked about seats and a discount, and how you paid.
practice.answer: Imagine that I am at a movie theater to buy two tickets for an evening showing. I ask about standard and premium seats, and I choose standard seats on the aisle so we can sit together. I also ask about a student discount, show my student ID, and pay by card. The clerk tells me when the doors open and emails the tickets to my phone. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Watching movies
practice.prompt: Why do some people prefer watching movies at a theater instead of at home?
practice.answer: The screen and the sound at a theater are usually better, and it can feel more special to go out. Some people also like choosing seats and watching with a large audience. At home it is more convenient, but it is easier to get distracted.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读，再完成口头练习。
practice.answer: 用四到六句在售票处说明你想买哪一场的两张票、想坐靠过道的座位、询问有没有学生优惠，并问该什么时候入场。
